issues.description: The template's Lecture constructor signature accepts only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), but the problem statement UML and the solution expect five attributes and a constructor with five parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). This mismatch can confuse students about the required constructor signature and prevent them from implementing the intended design or matching tests that expect the five-argument constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture constructor to match the UML and solution by accepting all five parameters in the specified order (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and initialize the corresponding attributes. Alternatively, remove the incomplete constructor stub so students implement the full constructor themselves.
